title: 7000: Fix mindmap rendering issue when Level 2 nodes exceed 11
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

This PR fixes an issue where mindmap Level 2 nodes beyond the 11th rendered incorrectly.  
Affected nodes appeared in black and were disconnected from the graph
Resolves #7000

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body:
Where does this 11 come from?
Avoid magic numbers

comments.author: darshanr0107
comments.body: The number 11 comes from `MAX_SECTIONS - 1` (12 - 1), where  MAX_SECTIONS corresponds to `THEME_COLOR_LIMIT` in the theme configuration.

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body: Then please use those constants here instead of 11.

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body: Otherwise if someone increases MAX_SECTIONS, this 11 won't be changed.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: The comment flags a magic number (11) and requests it be replaced with a named constant, implying a concrete code change.

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body:
Shouldn't it be this?

```suggestion
        const childSectionNumber = node.level === 0 ? index % (MAX_SECTIONS - 1) : sectionNumber;
```

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: The comment provides a direct code suggestion to change the implementation, which is explicitly actionable.
